name: pdfview
description: Shows PDFs in a StageWebView webview on every platform it supports: the webview's own viewer on Windows, macOS and iOS, and a bundled PDF.js on Linux and Android, where the webview has none.
releasenote: First release: PdfView.show() for webview.WebView and openfl.media.StageWebView, with PDF.js 4.10.38 bundled for Linux and Android.
